text:
maria (Product): Heads-up: ACME wants a private pilot in ~3w. Sales says HSM is a must for their compliance team. We have a prewarm conflict with Beacon. Can we map options quickly?

jay (Eng): Two levers: accept KMS-only pilot with documented limitations, or shift capacity slot. Runtime/time to support HSM is nontrivial.

ravi (Runtime): HSM integration impacts attestation and signing flows. Without HSM we can stub attestation and run feature-flagged pilot. Perf-wise, fallback model keeps API parity. Estimate 5 days to hook smoke harness + canary.

keiko (Infra): Current GPU prewarm windows: May03 (earmarked Beacon) and May17. If Beacon moves to May17 we can slot ACME on May03. Otherwise ACME lands May17. Need product decision plus owner confirmation from Beacon PO.

amir (Security): HSM onboarding + audit: approx 10 business days once questionnaire filled. KMS-only pilot (no attestation) is possible in 2-3 business days if legal oks documented deviation. Also need encrypted logs path verified.

maria (Product): Do we have a minimum pilot acceptance list that can use KMS temporarily?

jay (Eng): Minimal: 1) tenant isolation verified 2) billing tokens match contract 3) canary traffic run (50-100 users) 4) rollback behavior and fallback model validated 5) documented temporary compliance caveat (KMS).

ravi (Runtime): I'll prepare a smoke harness and a canary playbook. ETA 3 business days. Will include perf runner for 512-token median and 99th checks.

keiko (Infra): Provisional reservation created via runbook: 

```
reserver create --name acme-pilot --slot May17 --gpus A100:4 --provisional
```

If Beacon agrees to move I'll flip slot to May03. Tagging infra-ops to confirm burst pool.

deploy-bot: reservation slot-ACME-May17 created (provisional).

amir (Security): Sent questionnaire to ACME security contact. Copying maria. If answers in 48h we can fast-track HSM but still likely on May17.

maria (Product): Action items: (1) I'll ask Beacon PO to consider moving; (2) confirm ACME will accept KMS fallback if we need to; (3) update launch tracker. Reconvene Tue 09:30 for final decision. :white_check_mark:
